# Signet Artists

> A Denver company covering private events across Colorado — jazz through a full dance floor, two players to thirteen. Published pricing, production included, and a named contact for the night given to you in advance.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, the Front Range, and the mountain corridor. Rates are published rather than quoted on request; the full card is on the pricing page.

## Pages

- [Check a Date](https://signetartists.com/contact/): Send your date and we'll confirm availability and a price, usually within one business day.
- [Corporate & Galas](https://signetartists.com/corporate/): Live music for Denver corporate parties, galas and conferences. Certificate of insurance, W-9, one itemised invoice, net-30 available, and published pricing.
- [Signet Artists — Live music for private events, run like a business.](https://signetartists.com/): A Denver company covering private events across Colorado — jazz through a full dance floor, two players to thirteen. Published pricing, production included, and a named contact for the night given to you in advance.
- [The Music](https://signetartists.com/music/): Two bands and a DJ — The Standards for jazz and lounge, The Headliners for a dance floor. Two players to thirteen.
- [For Planners](https://signetartists.com/planners/): How we work with planners: a named contact in advance, paperwork before you ask, published pricing you can forward, and unbundling treated as normal.
- [Pricing](https://signetartists.com/pricing/): Published rates for live music at private events in Denver and the Colorado mountain corridor. Call-out plus hourly, production included, no overtime rate.

## Rates

- Duo: $600 call-out + $450/hour. Four hours = $2,400.
- Trio: $1,000 call-out + $600/hour. Four hours = $3,400.
- Quartet: $1,600 call-out + $800/hour. Four hours = $4,800.
- Quintet: $2,200 call-out + $1,000/hour. Four hours = $6,200.
- Seven-piece: $3,500 call-out + $1,250/hour. Four hours = $8,500.
- Ten-piece: $5,300 call-out + $1,800/hour. Four hours = $12,500.
- Thirteen-piece: $8,000 call-out + $2,500/hour. Four hours = $18,000.
- DJ: $800 call-out + $350/hour. Four hours = $2,200.

Price = call-out + (hours x hourly rate). There is no overtime rate. Adding a smaller group to an existing booking bills at the hourly rate only, with no second call-out.
